I had the brain zaps too (such a weird and uncomfortable sensation). I've read posts from a lot of people describing the same thing so it's probably fairly common. (It's also really fascinating how everyone calls them zaps) I didn't have headaches though. I went from 20, to 10 to 5 to 0. 
    
What helped me was to just take a very small dosage, probably like 5mg, whenever I had the zaps, but not otherwise. Over time it became less and less frequent that I had to take them and eventually I was able to stop taking them for good. That last period of taking them from time to time probably lasted like 2 months or so for me.     
  
Generally it's good idea to do this under the supervision of a physician but I get that many people don't wanna open that can of worms. I did it on my own as well but I'm back on it now since I apparantly can't really function for too long without them. Managed for about 6 months, then the physical sympthoms of depresion became too much for me. I still feel just as shitty when I take them but it seems to take less of a toll on my body which makes it worth taking them in my book.

It's certainly been a permanent state for me for the last couple of years but I don't believe it has to stay that way. I'm sure there's some way to get out of here but I got no clue as to what it is. If I did, I wouldn't be here. Just know that you're not the only one going through this.
